text:
alice: Quick sync — planning rollout for the tenant-gated regional-fallback routing feature. Proposal: tenant opt-in -> shadow -> tenant canary -> regional ramp -> global. Need guardrails, A/B criteria, and fallback policy. thoughts?

raj: +1. high-level: shadow for 48h, then 1% tenant cohort for 72h, then 5% -> 25% -> 100. Monitor P95 latency, error rate, routing mismatch, and cost delta.

maria: Also need explicit alert thresholds and a circuit breaker. Suggest: page if error rate >2% for 5m OR successful requests drop >30% vs baseline. All metrics instrumented by route + tenant.

sam: Ops notes: flag naming and playbook please. We'll want a per-tenant kill switch and global flag. Also schedule deploy during low-traffic window (Tue 0200-0500 PT) unless customers require earlier.

ben: From CS: include customer opt-in flow + a simple FAQ. A handful of enterprise customers asked to be in early cohort — we should reserve a manual opt-in bucket.

alice: Good call. Plan to reserve up to 5 tenants (manual opt-in) for early testing before the 1% random cohort.

raj: Example feature flag config (for ops/devs):
```
flag: tenant_gate_canary_v1
rules:
  - type: manual_bucket
    tenants: ["tenant-acme", "tenant-beta-inc"]
    duration: 72h
  - type: random_sampling
    percent: 1
    duration: 72h
fallbacks:
  - type: model_variant
    target: small-quantized
  - type: region_failover
    targets: ["us-east-1", "us-west-2"]
```

sam: CLI to flip the manual bucket quickly: `./flags set tenant_gate_canary_v1 --tenant tenant-acme --on` — add this to runbook.

maria: Telemetry checklist: route-level P50/P95, request success rate, backend error breakdown, token cost per request, KV cache hit rate, and a sampling of full request+response for evals. We need dashboards and 15m rolling alerts before ramp.

ben: For A/B evaluation, product wants one clear primary metric: "response quality" is fuzzy — propose 1) error-free completion rate and 2) cost-per-1k-tokens as secondary. We'll run short manual eval prompts for quality regressions.

alice: Agreement items so far:
- Preflight: shadow traffic 48h for all tenants (no user-facing change).
- Early manual bucket: up to 5 tenants for manual opt-in testing (72h).
- Canary: 1% random tenant cohort for 72h.
- Ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 72h stabilization windows.
- Gates: P95 latency increase <15% vs baseline; error rate delta <0.5% absolute; cost delta <10% (per-token). If any gate fails, rollback.

raj: Add automated rollback triggers:
- failure_conditions: [
  "error_rate_absolute > 0.02 for 5m",
  "successful_qps drop > 30% in 5m",
  "P95_latency_increase > 0.15"
]
Action: flip `tenant_gate_canary_v1` off for affected tenants + notify #eng-oncall + page SRE.

maria: Make sure we implement staged fallback behavior: first try model_variant fallback (lower perf but stable), then region_failover if persistent. That gives fastest user recovery.

sam: Runbook outline (short):
1) Preflight checklist (dashboards, alert hooks, backups).
2) Shadow run command + verify sampling.
3) Flip manual buckets for reserved tenants.
4) Start 1% canary via flag rule.
5) Observe for 72h, follow gating.
6) Ramp and communicate.
7) If automated rollback triggers, follow emergency path (page + incident).

ben: Customer comms: email + in-app note for opt-in tenants, include rollback SLA and how to opt-out. Coordinate with account owners ahead of manual bucket.

alice: Two open questions: 1) Should A/B be randomized per tenant or per request? 2) How long to keep shadow data for evals?

raj: Randomize per tenant for rollout safety (avoid per-request variability for same customer). Keep shadow recordings for 14 days; eval samples kept longer (30d) for quality comparisons.

maria: Ops: we must mask PII from shadow traces before storing. Add redaction step to the pipeline.

alice: Timeline proposal: start preflight today, shadow Mon-Tue, manual bucket Wed-Thu, 1% Fri-Mon, ramp next week. Adjust if manual customers need different windows.

sam: I'll lock down the deploy window and add the CLI commands to the ops runbook.

raj: I'll open a PR with flag rules + unit tests and link the config here.

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: Tue 02:00-04:00 PT; will run smoke checks post-deploy.

alice: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll draft the rollout doc and checklist and ping for final sign-off by EOD. :thumbsup:
